title: pssc trace slice --json
description: Every access to one register in a test trace (access events with that reg, debug images), in trace order, each with the statement that made it. Fields not listed here may be added; readers ignore them.

index.description: The event's index (seq) in the trace.

text.description: The source line, when the file is found.

fields.description: The register's field values in data.

stmt.description: The statement that made the access: the frame's last stmt event before it; null in a trace without stmt events (C engine, simulation).
